regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: The actual article title and aggregate CuI/ZnBr2/Ti(OEt)4 one-pot allene synthesis claim were inspected. The page advertises Supporting Information, but workspace SI association is unestablished and no SI fact was imported.

The upper CdI2/pyrrolidine arrow is explicitly previous 2013 work and is classified as a literature example. The lower CuI/ZnBr2/Ti(OEt)4/pyrrolidine arrow is the generic current reaction class and is classified as a general scheme, not an experiment-specific yield record.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–6, and footnotes
regions.finding: Six independent optimization conditions were retained with row x/y equivalents, copper identity or omission, shared ZnBr2/Ti(OEt)4/toluene/120 °C conditions, 10/12/18 h times, product-specific 3aa/4aa NMR yields, and the distinct 55% isolated 3aa outcome in entry 5. Both possible NMR internal standards are explicit participants because the footnote does not map them row-wise.

unresolved: Table S1 is cited but no SI file is associated or imported.
Table 1 does not map mesitylene versus CH2Br2 to individual rows.
Atmosphere, workup, purification, and isolated masses are absent.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left optimized-condition prose and Table 2 entries 1–14
regions.finding: Fourteen distinct ketone-scope experiments were retained with the shared 1a/ketone/pyrrolidine/CuI/ZnBr2/Ti(OEt)4/toluene conditions, isolated yields, and the 2.5:1 dr for entry 6. Narrative descriptions map to the rows and were not duplicated.
Two independent complex-ketone experiments were retained: tropinone 2p to 3ap (45%) and ketal 2q to 3aq (62%). Each arrow has its own ketone/product and is not folded into Table 2.

regions.region: page 2 center-right Table 3 entries 1–9 and footnotes
regions.finding: Nine independent alkyne/ketone scope experiments were retained. Entry 1 uses 3 equiv acetone and separately reports 55% product plus 23% recovered 1b; entry 8 retains 1:1 dr. All row yields remain isolated yields.
A separately performed 6 mmol/1-g-scale 1a+2c experiment gives 1.0556 g 3ac in 70%; it remains distinct from the 1 mmol Table 2 entry 2 (77%).
A distinct enantioenriched (S)-1b (99% ee) experiment gives (S)-3bc in 85% isolated yield and at least 97% ee; it is not merged with Table 3 entry 3.

regions.region: page 2 bottom-right start of control-experiment prose
regions.finding: The prose begins the no-Cu one-pot control and continues on page 3; it is represented once with cross-page evidence as Scheme 3 equation 5 control 1.

unresolved: Scope schemes omit atmosphere/workup/purification and most isolated masses.
Scheme 2 yield bases and compact product structures are unresolved.
The ee analytical method in equation 4 is not stated.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left continuation of Scheme 3 equation 5 prose
regions.finding: Three separate one-pot controls were retained: no Cu gives no 3aa and 9% NMR 4aa; no ZnBr2 gives 16% 3aa/39% 4aa by NMR; no Ti(OEt)4 gives neither product. Omitted reagents are not encoded as zero amounts.

regions.region: page 3 center-left Scheme 3 equation 6 prose and table
regions.finding: Four isolated-4aa conversion controls were retained separately for CuI only, ZnBr2 only, Ti(OEt)4 only, and CuI+ZnBr2. Product yield and recovered 4aa remain distinct target-specific outcomes. The prose's phrase 'no allene 4aa' conflicts with the scheme labels and is preserved as unresolved.
The seven Scheme 3 condition rows correspond to seven independent experiments; none was merged merely because all target 3aa or use 4aa.

Alkynylmetal 5, ketoniminium 6, propargylic amine 4, and complex 7 form a proposed mechanism involving 1,5-hydride transfer and beta-elimination; proposed intermediates are not treated as isolated experiments.

The SI availability sentence does not establish workspace association. Reproduction of Table 2 entries 3/10 and Table 3 entry 6 is provenance only because no independent run details are given; notes are attached to those existing records and no duplicates are created.

unresolved: Control yield/recovery analytical bases and detection limits are mostly unstated.
The prose mislabels 4aa as an allene in the Ti(OEt)4-only discussion.
Reproduction acknowledgments do not define separable runs; SI remains unassociated.

regions.finding: The entire page is bibliography/prior-literature context. It contains no current-paper reaction arrow, table row, experimental operation, quantity, yield, or new mechanistic step, so no reaction record is assigned to this page.

unresolved: No chemical experiment is present on this page; cited external papers were not expanded into experiments of the current article.
